6.author: AI Engineer

7.title: The different levels of how Claude thinks
7.author: Anthropic

8.title: The Future Is Domain-Specific Agents - Justin Schroeder, StandardAgents
8.author: AI Engineer
8.hook: Domain-specific agents succeed because businesses need custom data integration into AI, not because generic LLMs are insufficient — the constraint is orchestration and durable execution, not model capability.

9.title: Voice In, Visuals Out: The Agony and the Ecstasy - Allen Pike, Forestwalk Labs
9.author: AI Engineer
9.hook: Voice-in-visuals-out is more tractable than voice-in-voice-out; the latency ceiling for natural conversation (200ms) is nearly impossible, but visual responses forgive ~1000ms, making agent-as-product via voice input viable now.

10.title: You Can't Prompt the Room: The Last Skill AI Won't Replace - Balázs Horváth, VisualLabs
